Definition: Tsur, the name of a Midianite and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Zur is the name of two men, a Midianite prince killed in the days of Moses and an Israelite of Benjamin. In Numbers 25:15, the daughter of Zur. The fuller story is told on the Zur profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Zur belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
